_comment: Bedrock on-demand token rates for the model in BEDROCK_MODEL_ID, in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Derived from real billed usage, not from a pricing page: the public Bedrock pricing page has no Sonnet 4.5 entry and the AWS Price List API publishes no Anthropic SKUs for eu-west-1, so Cost Explorer against actual usage is the only traceable source. See `source` for the exact derivation.
source: AWS Cost Explorer, account 549116506173, service 'Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Amazon Bedrock Edition)', RECORD_TYPE=Usage, June 2026. Usage type EU-MP:EU_InputTokenCount-Units: $0.2514501 over 0.076197 Units (millions of tokens) = $3.3000000000/1M. Usage type EU-MP:EU_OutputTokenCount-Units: $0.1509585 over 0.009149 Units = $16.5000000000/1M. Both divisions land on exact round figures, so these are the published rates rather than an artifact of rounding. Note these are 1.10x the Anthropic first-party rates ($3/$15) -- the EU marketplace uplift -- so first-party pricing must not be substituted here.
